subject: Post-call: ZenHealth expansion — volumes, target $/1M & model routes
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@zenhealth.com>; Anya Sinha <anya@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: ZenHealth expansion — volumes, target $/1M & model routes

Thanks for the call earlier, Rajiv — good sync. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can land a procurement-ready quote.

Call recap (high level):
- ZenHealth plans to expand conversational and batch embedding traffic over the next 12 months.
- Key asks: target blended $/1M tokens you’re aiming for, whether you can commit to a term/initial minimum, and timing for adding reranking and embedding routes.

Open items for ZenHealth to confirm:
1) Expected month 1 baseline and 12-month ramp by route (chat/generation, embedding, reranking). Please see the attached token breakdown where I added columns for token type.
2) Target blended unit economics — you mentioned a target in the ~$650–750 range per 1M tokens on the call; can you confirm a precise target and whether that’s for committed or usage-based pricing?
3) Any procurement constraints (PO cadence, required contract language) we should surface to Legal now.

Our suggested next steps:
- You confirm the volume table in the attached Excel by EOD Wednesday PST.
- We’ll model three pricing options and send a procurement-ready quote + SOW draft: 12-month reserved commit (best blended), 6-month step-up, and pure usage (no commit).
- If the 12-month commit makes sense, Ben will run the blended math and Laura will prepare the SLA/throughput appendix.

Attaching: zenhealth_token_breakdown_v2.xlsx (token split + sample traffic distribution). Also adding a short PDF with our initial price banding thought.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@zenhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Anya Sinha <anya@zenhealth.com>; ZenHealth Procurement <procurement@zenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call: ZenHealth expansion — volumes, target $/1M & model routes

Jordan — thanks for the notes. Quick answers inline:  

1) Volumes (rough, per month) — baseline now vs target in 12 months:
   - Chat/generation: 25M -> 90M tokens
   - Embeddings (batch): 5M -> 20M tokens
   - Reranking (optional route): 0.5M -> 10M tokens

   We'll validate these numbers with product and confirm in the spreadsheet.

2) Target unit economics: we are looking to get to a blended ~$700 / 1M tokens for a committed arrangement. That target assumes we would commit to a 12-month minimum and can provide monthly visibility (forecast +/- 15%).

3) Procurement constraints: standard PO, electronic signature OK, but we do require standard data processing addendum (DPA). Procurement will need a line-item quote and SOW. CC'ing procurement.

Timing: Can you get a procurement-ready quote and SOW draft by Thursday EOD Pacific? That would keep us on track for procurement review next week.

— Rajiv
Senior Director, Platform Product
ZenHealth

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@zenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-call: ZenHealth expansion — volumes, target $/1M & model routes

Looping in pricing. Based on Rajiv's target ($700 / 1M) and the ramp profile, here's a quick banded approach we can present to procurement — put together as illustrative blended math so Jordan can include in the quote.

Suggested banded unit pricing (illustrative):
- 0 - 10M: $1,000 / 1M tokens
- 10 - 50M: $820 / 1M tokens
- 50 - 150M: $660 / 1M tokens
- Reserved capacity (12mo commit) blended target if they hit the ramp above: ~$700 / 1M tokens

Notes:
- Reranking and embedding requests are cheaper in marginal cost but will change the blended math; we need the token-proportion table filled out to give a precise blended quote.
- If ZenHealth requires hard caps or guaranteed throughput per model route, we need that in the SOW appendix.

Action: Jordan — I'll assemble a quote template with the bands and model-route appendix. Laura, please pull the SLA throughput addendum.

— Ben
Head of Pricing, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@zenhealth.com>; Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, ZenHealth Procurement <procurement@zenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-call: ZenHealth expansion — volumes, target $/1M & model routes

Thanks Rajiv — attaching a short SOW draft and SLA appendix for review (SOW_draft_zenhealth.docx). A few procurement notes:
- We will include line items for reserved GPU capacity if they opt for a dedicated pool.
- The DPA template is standard; procurement can send suggested edits.
- For the embedded/reranking routes, we recommend a 30-day validation period post-live to instrument prefix caching so we can optimize unit cost.

Jordan: Ben and I are aligned to deliver the procurement-ready package by Thursday EOD PT. Sending attachments now.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success & Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@zenhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: ZenHealth expansion — volumes, target $/1M & model routes

Appreciate the fast turnaround team. The banding looks sensible — the ~$700 blended on a 12-month commit is workable for us if we get the line-item quote and SOW this week.

Procurement, please confirm you can review the SOW and return any comments by next Wednesday so we can route for signature the following week.

Jordan — once you send the formal quote, I'll share it with Finance for a final sign-off.

Thanks,
Rajiv

On a process note: please include an explicit rollback/fallback policy in the SOW for when we add reranking (we need latencies guaranteed).
